result.note: Tested the first eastern-sector corps commander talks at Wacha-Damai and NITI Aayog's electric-truck platforms; Xi's visit is used only as a dated detail.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the India–China corps commander-level talks held in September 2026:
items: They were held at the Wacha-Damai point in Arunachal Pradesh.
Since the 2020 Galwan clash, such talks had been held only in Ladakh on the western frontier.
They came days before Xi Jinping's visit for the BRICS summit, his first India trip since 2014.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 3 is wrong because the story says Xi's BRICS visit was his first India trip since 2019, not 2014. These were the first corps commander-level talks in the eastern sector, in Arunachal Pradesh, which China claims as South Tibet.
questions.source: Since the 2020 Galwan clash, such talks had happened only in Ladakh on the western frontier.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about India's electric-truck sector in September 2026:
items: NITI Aayog launched two platforms to accelerate electric-truck adoption.
Chinese brands such as SANY and Foton held less than a fifth of the nascent electric-truck market.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because the story says SANY and Foton already held more than half of the nascent market. Electric vehicles attract just a 10% import duty, which Tata Motors wants fixed.
questions.source: NITI Aayog launched two platforms to accelerate electric-truck adoption, but Chinese brands SANY and Foton already hold more than half a nascent market, and electric vehicles attract just a 10% import duty that Tata Motors wants fixed.
